package main
import("encoding/json";"fmt";"os";"unicode/utf16";collapse "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/tailwind/collapse")
func main(){
 source,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 var cases []struct{Input string `json:"input"`;Separator byte `json:"separator"`}
 if err:=json.Unmarshal(source,&cases);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 for _,row:=range cases{
  parts:=collapse.AdamicSegment(row.Input,row.Separator);fmt.Printf("%d:",len(parts))
  for _,part:=range parts{fmt.Print("[");for _,unit:=range utf16.Encode([]rune(part)){fmt.Printf("%d,",unit)};fmt.Print("]")};fmt.Println()
 }
}
